title: At-least-once delivery without doing the work twice
summary: Consume a queue that redelivers: dedupe by key, retry with a bound, and dead-letter what will never succeed.
declaredTests: processes each message id exactly once under redelivery
retries a transient failure and then succeeds
dead-letters a message after the retry bound
keeps a failing message from blocking the rest
reports the same result for a duplicate arriving after success
